# Construction and admission boundary

## 1. Pinned operators

PR568 at `71c99ac935a33bb7b59a1b4a7af8725a939b0b90` supplies the plain
eight-promotion/eight-cold word. Its complete package is retained unchanged
and freshly replayed. We use its `eight-cold-local` output, which is the
verified final **eight-cold** word despite that inherited directory name.

PR569 at `f1db606a1416359229f944946667338305208064` supplies the 32 entrance
recipes and frame-closure constructor. Its scientific code is identical to
the independently replayed `897213a855b7fb8a1b8b0e552a2f5c42e6c1b326`;
the later commit changes attribution and the source manifest. Only the
specified source files are retained. Their original notices are unchanged.

The constructor raises the selected entrances from rank one to rank two and
propagates their frame joins. Each affected gate still has a legal shared
frame and every register still follows a nested frame chain. The source's
center frames, target levels, ports, scalar operations, coefficients, order,
preconditioning and scalar cleanup are fixed. An independent comparison,
also run with Python optimization enabled, verifies these statements and
rejects changed coefficients, an unlisted entrance and reordered cleanup.

Changing these annotations does not change the scalar operator or its
inverse transpose. It does change residual widths, paid climbs and phase
recipes, so all of those are reconstructed. Fresh arbitrary-dirt column
replay, reflected ledgers, normalized wrappers and every exact phase edge
are required; scalar identity alone is insufficient admission.

## 2. Literal ownership

The frozen plan selects 57 promoted and 15 plain providers at individually
specified stage/replica positions. Each of the 72 complete invocations has
504 whole helper owners. The independent auditor checks all owner windows,
unique families per invocation, ordered widths, disjoint prefix cells,
spectators, orthogonal 73-column charts, reflected orientation, bridges and
terminal translations. It also rejects 16 controller mutations.

The actual positive idle remainders are
`{2:17,3:1209,7:5,48:1815}`. Thus

```
H_global = 15 H_plain + 57 H_promoted + H_idle
         = {1:169728,2:40529,3:26169,4:13824,
            5:4032,6:4032,7:5,8:576,48:1815}.
73 * 7168 - sum(r * H_global[r]) = 2560.
```

The physical stock is `7168 + 504 + 8 + 2 = 7682`. The 514 private registers
are shared only under the freshly checked erasure/restoration contracts.
No helper is split among unrelated families or child blocks.

### Discovery expansion argument

For a bin pattern with `n` copies and `c_w` slots of width `w`, the search
uses integer flows `y[t,w]` satisfying

```
sum_t y[t,w] = n*c_w,     sum_w y[t,w] <= n.
```

Split each width into `c_w` right vertices, distributing its flow so each
right vertex has degree `n`. Left vertices are invocation times and have
degree at most `n`. Add dummy right vertices and edges to obtain a square
`n`-regular bipartite multigraph. Repeated perfect matchings decompose it
into `n` bins. Every bin has the specified width multiset and uses each
invocation time at most once. Assigning the actual helper indices then gives
the literal owner records, all rechecked with integers.

Solver objectives are discovery heuristics. Solver optimality is not used
as a proof. The released admission path reads only the frozen plan/owners
and verifies them independently; SciPy and graph matching are not required.

## 3. Complete cost and exact assembly

The invoice recounts every actual scalar macro, dyadic coefficient operation,
wrapper, adapter, bridge, sweep and retained compiler allowance. Each provider
has 16270 scalar macros per orientation and 220 entering-helper wrappers at
each end. Forward/backward real-component primitive counts are 161072 and
161120; coefficient-work counts are 79756 and 79788. The promoted provider's
frame work changes its event count, so provider selection is charged per call.
The maximum scalar prefix is independently bounded over both actual providers
and reflected orientations. All finite row, tape, precision, mass and routing
inequalities are freshly evaluated.

The conservative complex model is checked first. PR559's inherited reviewed
native exact-cover correction is applied only to the complex moment. The
unchanged PR543 bit profile is cited and repriced with its surcharge retained;
this package does not reconstruct that bit circuit.

Two independent rational engines accept the supplier lower endpoints and
reject the adjacent `10^-24` endpoints. Both models pass seven bootstrap
levels, 47 strict outer conditions and next-grid/parameter controls. The
native endpoint is `b=0.001603101600089641927176`; the accepted grid value is
`kappa=0.001600535778621932`. The conservative endpoint is
`0.001603101597294526650152`, with `kappa=0.001600535775835757`.

The 93 assembly mutations include missing orientations, changed ordered
widths, all seven extra cold-helper permutations, every width-seven entrance,
forged artifacts, moved provider positions, internally compensated false
profiles and understated cost/stock. Timing-only phase receipt changes are
accepted after rebinding; semantic changes are rejected.

## 4. Weakest remaining implications

The exact finite construction does not establish the all-size compiler,
uniform common labels or mutable-source realization, normalized recursive
residual interface, correlated whole-call hosting theorem, all-size precision
and tape implementation, exact recovery, or analytic transfer. These remain
the inherited assumptions. The cited bit supplier retains H1–H5. The finite
invoice verifies its explicit arithmetic consequences, not those general
theorems. No universal optimality, full Lean certification or practical
multiplication speed claim follows.

## Portable generated identities

The generated-artifact identity map follows pinned PR567. For gzip outputs it
hashes the exact decompressed payload. JSON is canonicalized with all fields
retained; the native receipt's two gzip references and the phase receipt's
canonical-word and recipe references are first checked against actual raw files,
then replaced by the corresponding payload/JSON hashes. Only the phase receipt's
root timing is omitted after finite, nonnegative, non-boolean validation. All
other timing fields remain proof data. The owner and invoice independently bind
all seven identities per provider, and assembly checks their frozen values.
Actual recompression controls rebind all raw and semantic links; substantive
scalar, frame, native-proof and phase changes still fail admission.
